item.title: saltFrame 0.1.0
item.description:
• The first saltFrame for friends: a photo library for Mac that takes over from Lightroom Classic's Library.
  • Start from Lightroom Classic: pick the folder where your photos are, and saltFrame brings in your catalog's ratings, flags, labels, keywords and collections. Your photos and your Lightroom catalog are never changed.
  • Browse every photo on one timeline and rate and flag with Lightroom's keys.
  • Updates arrive by themselves; saltFrame › Check for Updates… looks now.
  • Needs macOS 27 on an Apple silicon Mac. This is an alpha: tell AJ what breaks.

item.title: saltFrame 0.1.1
item.description:
• Start from Lightroom Classic through Import › Lightroom catalog…: pick your .lrcat, see its photos, and choose to keep them where they are or copy them into your library. Ratings, flags, labels, keywords and collections come along. Your photos and your Lightroom catalog are never changed.
  • Import from camera cards, external drives and folders, several at once. saltFrame asks once per drive whether to look for photos there; Settings › Import › Drives lists your answers.
  • Every import can be undone: from the activity panel or Settings › Import.
  • Keywords and collections: collections above the browse icons, keywords offered as you type in search.
  • Export originals or JPEGs, share, and edit in another app, from the File menu or by right-clicking a photo. Location is left out unless you tick Include location.
  • Zoom in the loupe with the pill at the bottom right, a pinch, or ⌘-scroll.
  • One activity widget at the top right shows everything saltFrame is doing and what hardware it runs on.
  • Background work waits while you import or export and slows down when your Mac is short on memory.
  • Find photos from Spotlight and Siri; a monthly check of your library's files; duplicates; face counts for culling (counts only, never who).
  • saltFrame speaks English and Dutch (Settings › General › Language).
  • Needs macOS 27 on an Apple silicon Mac. This is an alpha: tell AJ what breaks.
